categories.criteriaEn: Any film genre, subgenre or widely recognised style or category of film (for example found footage, mockumentary, slasher, anime, biopic, rom com).

categories.criteriaEn: Any programming, scripting, query or shader language, current or historical, general purpose or domain specific (SQL, Bash, Lua, COBOL, GLSL count). Pure markup or data formats like HTML, CSS, JSON, XML do not count.

categories.en: Name a sea creature

Seabirds and penguins count. Reject plants, objects, places, people, freshwater only animals and mythical creatures (mermaid, kraken).
